label: vision_footnote
text: The N.Y.K. steamer Hakozaki Maru preparatory to leaving Hongkong for Europe with H.R.H. Prince Chichibu on board last Saturday. The second son of the Mikado was up on the bridge waving to the naval tenders at the foot of the gangway when this snapshot was taken.

label: vision_footnote
text: The giant cake at the Hongkong Hotel roof garden reception for the guests who attended the wedding last Saturday of Mr. N. B. White of Hongkong and Miss Pearl Clifford Thompson of Philadelphia (see Page 1).

label: vision_footnote
text: Photo courtesy A. Fong.

label: vision_footnote
text: Last Saturday afternoon the foundation-stone was laid at the new building for the St. Paul's Girls' College between Kennedy Road and Macdonnell Road. This photo shows Mr. Colbourne Little (architect) and H.E. the Governor (Sir R. E. Stubbs) with the silver trowel with which he performed the ceremony.

label: vision_footnote
text: Photos by Mee Fong.

label: vision_footnote
text: Left to right: Mr. Li Po-kwai, Miss Woo (headmistress), the Hon. Mr. R. H. Kotewall (chairman, building committee), H.E. the Governor, the Right Rev. C. R. Duppuy (Bishop of Victoria), the Rev. Li Kau-yan, Mr. Little, the Rev. A. D. Stewart (behind) and Mr. Lam Woo.

label: vision_footnote
text: Photo courtesy A. Fong.

label: vision_footnote
text: Right to left (front row):—Rev. A. D. Stewart, the Bishop of Victoria, H.E. the Governor, Miss Woo, Mr. T. J. Gaisford-St. Lawrence (Private Secretary to H.E.) and Mr. Li Po-kwai listening to Mr. Kotewall's address from the table.

label: vision_footnote
text: Photo courtesy A. Fong.

label: vision_footnote
text: The Bishop pronouncing the blessing after the dedication. Facing the camera between the Rev. Mr. Stewart and H.E. the Governor is Mr. E. Ralphs, inspector of English schools.

label: vision_footnote
text:
Photo by Msa Fong.
Inside the matshed decorated with streamers and bunting, the ceremony was held with interested spectators and student drawn up in groups outside. In the background is the tower of Union Church, Kennedy Road.
